flags.why: The common meaning ‘inner part’ of an object or food is missing, as documented in the [dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ru%E1%BB%99t).
flags.fix: noun | inner part; interior; flesh (of fruit) — ex: Quả thanh long này có ruột màu đỏ. = This dragon fruit has red flesh.

flags.why: Using ruột for a tyre’s inner tube is mainly Southern usage.

This dialectal verb is used in the Thanh–Nghệ area and needs a Central warning, as described in this [regional usage discussion](https://baomoi.com/ve-mot-so-tu-lay-thap-tho-the-le-tho-lo-thoi-loi-c52617723.epi).
Cừu denotes a wooden gymnastics vaulting apparatus rather than an athletics hurdle, according to the [dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BB%ABu).

The example refers to vaulting over a gymnastics apparatus, which the [dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BB%ABu) identifies as cừu, rather than jumping over a hurdle.
flags.fix: to vault over a buck with legs spread wide
